name: seed-api
description: Direct SEED API access for account data, schematics, markets and developer workflows.

interface.longDescription: Connect directly to Klang Games’ SEED API. Read seedlings, schematics, societies and the Global Market. Developer tools require the SEED MCP developer role and can change the game.
defaultPrompt: Show my seedlings and what they need right now.
Find the schematics for an item I want to craft.
Show my society and its current statistics.
